name: Podio
one_liner: Podio provides an API for integrating with its CRM and sales platform, allowing external applications to manage data and automate workflows.
access_note: Developers must register an application to obtain a Client ID and Client Secret for authentication.

evidence.quote: The Podio API uses the OAuth2 protocol for authentication.
Username & password flow. Use this flow only if none of the other flows are suitable. It requires the user's username and password to be shared.
Before you can use the Podio API you must register your application.
HTTP METHOD: POST URL: https://api.podio.com/oauth/token/v2 HEADER: "Content-Type: application/json"
Currently authentication and the app/item APIs are supported in their entirety, while some user and space functions are also available.
